scope: app/config.py (loud startup failure on missing secrets)
app/db.py, app/models.py (public_id vs internal id, ai_decision vs status)
human_decisions: Enforced separation between sequential internal id and random URL-safe public_id.
Kept ai_decision separate from publication status to support manual admin overrides.

scope: app/ai/parse.py & app/ai/mock.py (Pydantic v2 AIResult schema, deterministic mock triggers)
human_decisions: Discovered Groq 404s on deprecated Llama IDs; queried /models and switched AI_MODEL to openai/gpt-oss-20b.
Removed response_format: json_object after hitting http_400 on Groq, relying on SYSTEM_PROMPT + parse_ai_response.
Diagnosed JSON truncation caused by openai/gpt-oss-20b internal reasoning tokens (~166 tokens) and raised max_tokens from 200 to 500.
Enforced short error codes with `raise ... from None` so API keys, response bodies, and user stories never leak into logs or tracebacks.

scope: tests/test_validation.py (69 unit tests generated first as a TDD spec)
human_decisions: Hand-wrote the entire core validation and contact normalisation logic in app/validation.py against the 69-test TDD suite.
Verified live end-to-end submission flow in browser and Swagger /docs, confirming random public_id URLs, contact privacy, and XSS escaping.

sessions.phase: Phase 4 ? Admin Dashboard, Auth & CSRF Override
scope: app/admin.py (signed HttpOnly SameSite=Lax session cookies, require_admin guard, status filter, CSRF-protected override)
tests/test_security.py (14 unit tests) & tests/test_admin.py (17 integration & access-control tests)
human_decisions: Hand-wrote all 14 unit tests in tests/test_security.py and all 17 route/security tests in tests/test_admin.py.
Required admins to enter a fresh 1-12 word caption when overriding an AI-rejected entry to approved so AI rejection captions never publish to the wall.
Verified CSRF enforcement via deliberate sabotage run and tightened AI_PROVIDER validation in app/config.py.
